title: Mobile Golf Game
author: swiftyman
selftext:
Decided to start making a mobile golf game. Still working through some bugs, but overall pretty happy with how it's turning out. 

My original idea was "NES golf but 3d". I've diverged a little bit from that, but it's been a fun process. 

Done with Claude code and three.js, testing in a browser until I get the bugs and design all figured out.

replies.author: swiftyman
replies.body: Thanks! It's been a (mostly) fun process to see it come together haha

comments.author: VRSportz
comments.body: Looks great. I've been down a vibe coding rabbit hole working on top down 2d sports games. Golf has been one ive been struggling with so far!
